description: Operating-system health for every VM in the HQ and DR sites: PostgreSQL/Patroni nodes, etcd, HAProxy, the backup servers and the monitoring VM.

panels.title: Nodes Up
panels.description: node_exporter targets currently answering scrapes.

panels.title: Nodes Down
panels.description: Targets Prometheus cannot scrape right now.

panels.title: Min Disk Free
panels.description: Lowest free-space percentage across every real filesystem. A full disk stops WAL archiving and backups.

targets.expr: max(node_load1{job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} / on(instance) group_left() count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Min Uptime
panels.description: Shortest uptime in the selection — a low value means a recent reboot.

panels.title: Collector Failures
panels.description: node_exporter collectors that failed on the last scrape.

panels.title: CPU I/O Wait %
panels.description: High iowait on a PostgreSQL node usually means the data disk or the WAL disk is the bottleneck.

panels.title: CPU Steal % (hypervisor contention)
panels.description: Time the VM was ready to run but the Azure host gave the CPU to someone else. Sustained steal degrades etcd and Patroni timing.

targets.expr: node_load1{job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} / on(instance) group_left() count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"})

node_load5{job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} / on(instance) group_left() count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"})

node_load15{job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} / on(instance) group_left() count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Processes Running / Blocked
panels.description: Blocked processes are stuck in uninterruptible I/O.

panels.title: PSI — CPU Waiting
panels.description: Pressure Stall Information: fraction of time tasks were runnable but waiting for CPU.

panels.title: Memory Used %
panels.description: Based on MemAvailable, so the PostgreSQL page cache is not counted as used.

targets.expr: node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} - node_memory_MemFree_bytes{job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} - node_memory_Buffers_bytes{job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} - node_memory_Cached_bytes{job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"} - node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes{job=~"node_exporter_.*", site=~"$site", instance=~"$instance"}

panels.title: Swap Used
panels.description: Any sustained swapping on a database node is a problem.

panels.title: Dirty / Writeback Pages
panels.description: Large dirty page volumes make checkpoints and fsync spikes worse.

panels.title: Major Page Faults / s
panels.description: Faults that required a disk read — a direct sign of memory pressure.

panels.title: OOM Kills (selected range)
panels.description: The kernel OOM killer terminating processes — on a PostgreSQL node this usually kills a backend or the postmaster itself.

panels.title: Inodes Free %
panels.description: Running out of inodes fails writes even when free space remains — WAL archive directories create many small files.

panels.title: Read-only Filesystems
panels.description: A filesystem remounted read-only after an I/O error.

panels.title: Disk Utilization %
panels.description: Percentage of wall time the device had at least one I/O in flight.

panels.title: Disk Average Latency
panels.description: etcd needs fsync latency well under 25 ms — watch this on the PostgreSQL/etcd nodes.

panels.title: Network Traffic
panels.description: Replication between HQ and DR plus WAL shipping to the backup servers dominate this traffic.

panels.title: TCP Established Connections
panels.description: Includes application connections through HAProxy plus replication and etcd peer connections.

panels.title: TCP Retransmits / s
panels.description: Retransmits between HQ and DR indicate a lossy inter-site link.

panels.title: TCP Listen Drops / Overflows
panels.description: Accept queue overflow — HAProxy or PostgreSQL is not accepting connections fast enough.

panels.title: Conntrack Table Usage %
panels.description: A full conntrack table silently drops new connections.

panels.title: Clock Offset (NTP)
panels.description: Clock drift breaks etcd lease timing and makes PITR timestamps untrustworthy.

panels.title: Entropy Available
panels.description: Low entropy can stall TLS handshakes.

panels.title: Textfile Collector Errors
panels.description: Non-zero means node_exporter could not parse a .prom file — this is how the pgBackRest metrics are published, so a failure here makes backup monitoring stale.

title: Nodes / System — HQ & DR
